topics.description: Recent investigations and allegations of fraud in Minnesota have brought attention to the state's vulnerability to fraudulent activities. A 56-page roadmap for fraud prevention has been submitted to Gov. Walz and lawmakers.
topics.reason: Increased scrutiny on Minnesota's fraud prevention measures

topics.description: Allegations of embezzlement from the Fresno Arts Council have led to an investigation and the revelation of a woman's name in connection with the alleged $1.5M embezzlement.
topics.reason: New developments in the Fresno Arts Council embezzlement case
